title: THE KEYS LIST READS LIKE SETTINGS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus still look bad, take pictures and make it look like a triple A game. The picture review of the Keys window found the list running the whole width of the screen, small letter action names at one edge and plain boxes at the other. It is a narrower list on the left now, the action names in the same capitals as the Settings rows, and every key drawn as a keycap. No word changed.
now: The Keys window is a tidy list with the keys drawn as keycaps.
